project_type: Python FastAPI application - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode), fixtures in tests/conftest.py, uses unittest.mock (AsyncMock, MagicMock)
build_command: python -m py_compile on each source file (AST validation - no pip install available)
test_command: python -m pytest tests/ -x (after ensuring imports work via sys.path manipulation or PYTHONPATH)
verification_instructions: 1. Validate all new Python files parse correctly with ast.parse. 2. Run pytest on new test files using PYTHONPATH=src. 3. Confirm no import errors in new modules.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network means no pip install. Use pre-installed Python 3.11+ and validate via AST parsing and pytest for pure-logic tests.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no pip install, no external API calls, no Docker daemon. Code must be structurally valid (pass AST parse). Tests must test pure logic without network/DB dependencies. Git push to origin works.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify existing Phase 1/2 files unless necessary for integration (e.g., main.py route registration). Do NOT break existing functionality.
key_patterns: 1. AgentAdapter Protocol in runtime/adapter.py defines 11 async methods with AgentSession/TaskResult/AgentStatus dataclasses. 2. Routes use FastAPI APIRouter with Pydantic models for request/response. 3. Services are pure classes taking db session in constructor. 4. EventBus uses publish/subscribe pattern with typed event constants. 5. Tests use pytest classes (TestXxxYyy) with @pytest.mark.asyncio, AsyncMock for DB, sample fixtures in conftest.py. 6. All modules have detailed docstrings. 7. Budget/approval systems use in-memory dicts for state.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is the main package. api/routes/ has 16 route modules registered in main.py. models/ has 10 SQLModel modules. services/ has 5 service classes. runtime/ has adapter protocol and lifecycle. governance/ has approvals, budget, audit, rbac, guardrails, kill_switch. communication/ has event_bus, channels, a2a, group. orchestration/ has planner, router, parallel, critic, retry. tests/ has 12 test files with conftest.py.
